question: Find all cards illustrated by Kev Walker that either have no power value or an unknown power ('*'). For each such card, return its English name, all available foreign language names, the set code it belongs to, and the most recent ruling date. Only include cards that have at least one foreign flavor text entry. Order the results by the most recent ruling date in descending order, and within the same date, sort by card name alphabetically.

prediction.sql:
SELECT
    c."XCL_049" AS english_name,
    GROUP_CONCAT(fd."XCL_079") AS foreign_names,
    c."XCL_063" AS set_code,
    MAX(r."XCL_088") AS most_recent_ruling_date
FROM cards AS c
INNER JOIN foreign_data AS fd ON c."XCL_072" = fd."XCL_082"
LEFT JOIN rulings AS r ON c."XCL_072" = r."XCL_090"
WHERE c."XCL_002" = 'Kev Walker'
  AND (c."XCL_055" IS NULL OR c."XCL_055" = '*')
  AND fd."XCL_076" IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY c."XCL_001", c."XCL_049", c."XCL_063"
ORDER BY most_recent_ruling_date DESC, english_name ASC

react.initial_search_query: Find all cards illustrated by Kev Walker that either have no power value or an unknown power ('*'). For each such card, return its English name, all available foreign language names, the set code it belongs to, and the most recent ruling date. Only include cards that have at least one foreign flavor text entry. Order the results by the most recent ruling date in descending order, and within the same date, sort by card name alphabetically.

compiled_semantic_plan.candidate_sql:
SELECT
    c."XCL_049" AS english_name,
    GROUP_CONCAT(fd."XCL_079") AS foreign_names,
    c."XCL_063" AS set_code,
    MAX(r."XCL_088") AS most_recent_ruling_date
FROM cards AS c
INNER JOIN foreign_data AS fd ON c."XCL_072" = fd."XCL_082"
LEFT JOIN rulings AS r ON c."XCL_072" = r."XCL_090"
WHERE c."XCL_002" = 'Kev Walker'
  AND (c."XCL_055" IS NULL OR c."XCL_055" = '*')
  AND fd."XCL_076" IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY c."XCL_001", c."XCL_049", c."XCL_063"
ORDER BY most_recent_ruling_date DESC, english_name ASC

SELECT
    c."XCL_049" AS english_name,
    GROUP_CONCAT(fd."XCL_079") AS foreign_names,
    c."XCL_063" AS set_code,
    MAX(r."XCL_088") AS most_recent_ruling_date
FROM cards AS c
INNER JOIN foreign_data AS fd ON c."XCL_072" = fd."XCL_082"
LEFT JOIN rulings AS r ON c."XCL_072" = r."XCL_090"
WHERE c."XCL_002" = 'Kev Walker'
  AND (c."XCL_055" IS NULL OR c."XCL_055" = '*')
  AND fd."XCL_076" IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY c."XCL_001", c."XCL_049", c."XCL_063"
ORDER BY most_recent_ruling_date DESC, english_name ASC
